title: Didn't Work For Me
text:
Didn't Work For Me. The only reason I got this was to make french fries..It just makes....Mush! I tried several different ways, with oil, without oil leaving them in for 7-8 minutes, Mush!!
I was looking for an alternative to the Microwave Fries in the box. They work great, but every few weeks the price goes up. I'll just keep looking.
I'm not sure what to do with Grill Pan, it will grill stuff but everything comes out the same.

product_metadata.title: Microhearth Grill Pan for Microwave Cooking, Red
features: Grill delicious meals or even desserts in your microwave.
Microwave oven cooking speed & grilling taste.
Grill burgers, fish, chicken, chops, steaks, veggie and fruits.
Easy to clean & use nonstick coating.
description: Microhearth grill pan is a revolutionary pan used in your microwave that its cooking results may surprise you. The results are moist and flavorful foods that utilize the microwave oven's convenience; while enduring natural flavor and freshness. With this pan, you can saute and grill your favorite foods and recipes in the microwave in less time than usual. You'll find this cookware is easy to use and will soon become a favorite in you kitchen to grill sandwiches, vegetables, meat and fruit. A wise investment saving you both time and money. With microhearth grill pan, you can now enjoy your favorite foods and recipes at anytime and at wherever microwave oven is accessible. It is even great for rv, school dorm and break room. Microhearth grill pan is durable and high-heat resistant that components that nest together making it versatiles and compact for easy storage. Nonstick coated metal pan with raised base gives food seared grill marks and keeps them out of drippings. The durable body is formulated to safely perform under hottest temperatures. Ceramic-coated metal lid with standing handle allows you to conveniently rest it upright so moisture does not drip on the counter. Ceramic-coating is especially designed for use in the microwave and eliminates the "microwaves" that normally causes dryness by penetratin through the food druing cooking.
